caption: The drawing depicts a side view of a leaping dog figure, rendered in shades of gray pencil on an off-white background. The dog is shown in mid-leap with its front and hind legs extended. The body and legs of the dog show detailed shading, with texture lines suggesting the wood grain, and some outlined anatomical features such as the ribs and muscles. The head is drawn with a long snout and ears hanging downward. A vertical pole is visible beneath the dog, attached near its abdomen, indicating that the object is supported or mounted. The drawing is enclosed within a lined rectangular border. In the bottom left corner, there is a small ruler for scale, marked in feet and inches, and a handwritten name appears just above the ruler.
title: Running Dog Weather Vane
